What runs on Arc.
Juno is a social app where every post is a market. Arc is Circle’s chain for stablecoin finance: here is each piece of it Juno uses, what it does for you, what has been exercised on testnet, and whether this server has it configured.
USDC $1.000 · Chainlink
01
USDC as gas
CONFIGURED
Arc's native gas token is USDC.
Your wallet holds one token. Every price, fee, balance and gas cost is in dollars — a buy's gas is under half a cent.
Everywhere: the trade sheet, your wallet, every receipt. · USDC 0x3600…0000
RAN ON TESTNET  Testnet launch, buys and sell paid gas in USDC; a buy cost about $0.004.
02
Deterministic finality
CONFIGURED
Deterministic finality: a transaction is final in the block that includes it (about every half second), no reorgs.
A buy is final in about a second. The receipt leads with the measured time from submit to receipt, taken by Juno’s server.
Trade receipt · landing figures · deterministic, ~0.5 s blocks
RAN ON TESTNET  Blocks about every 0.5 s on testnet; measured 1.1–1.3 s from submit to receipt through Juno’s server.
03
Memo
CONFIGURED
Arc's Memo contract makes a call as your wallet and logs a reference beside it.
Each curve buy and sell is tagged with its post's id, so trades are findable by post on chain.
Trade receipt: “Tagged with this post via Arc Memo” · 0x5294…e505
RAN ON TESTNET  Testnet launch, buy, sell and relayed buy were Memo-tagged.
04
Gasless buys (EIP-3009)
CONFIGURED
USDC's receiveWithAuthorization: a signature moves the money, someone else pays the gas.
“Pay with signature — no gas”: you sign, Juno's relayer submits the buy and pays the USDC gas.
Trade sheet · relayer configured; requires USDC gas
RAN ON TESTNET  One relayed buy on testnet: the buyer paid exactly the trade, no gas.
05
Circle Gateway
CONFIGURED
A unified USDC balance across chains, Circle attests a burn intent and Juno’s relayer mints the USDC on Arc.
Deposit once on Base or Ethereum, spend it here; top up a buy from Gateway when Arc USDC is short.
Profile → wallet · trade sheet “Top up from Gateway” · 7 source chains
RAN ON TESTNET  Deposit from Arc exercised on testnet. Attestation and mint from another chain: not run on testnet.
06
Circle CCTP V2
CONFIGURED
Native USDC burned on one chain, minted on another.
Creators withdraw trading fees straight to Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana… as native USDC.
Creator earnings · coin page “Withdraw fees to…” · domain 26 · 11 destinations
RAN ON TESTNET  A real burn through TokenMessengerV2 on testnet; the mint on the other chain was not completed.
07
Chainlink CCIP Cross-Chain Tokens
CONFIGURED
A token pool per coin: burned on Arc, minted on the destination, rate-limited per lane.
A graduated coin's creator makes it cross-chain in one transaction; holders send it to Base Sepolia or Ethereum Sepolia, fee in USDC. Arc's supply can never exceed the launch supply.
Graduated coin page → Cross-chain · 4 lanes · router 0xdE4E…eab8
FORK-PROVEN  Contracts are deployed on testnet; enabling and sending a coin is proven on a fork of Arc testnet, not run live (a coin must graduate first).
08
Chainlink Data Feeds
CONFIGURED
Decentralised price feeds — BTC, ETH, SOL, LINK, gold, EUR, JPY… — read from Arc mainnet.
Trackers follow a feed: the coin page shows NAV, what the curve implies, the premium and the band. USDC's own peg is shown beside prices.
Trade → Trackers · tracker coin pages · the peg chip · 10 feeds on Arc mainnet
DISPLAY-ONLY  Feeds exist on Arc mainnet only: on testnet, prices are mainnet reads for display and nothing is marked on chain.

What runs on Arc.
Juno is a social app where every post is a market. Arc is Circle’s chain for stablecoin finance: here is each piece of it Juno uses, what it does for you, what has been exercised on testnet, and whether this server has it configured.
USDC $1.000 · Chainlink
01
USDC as gas
CONFIGURED
Arc's native gas token is USDC.
Your wallet holds one token. Every price, fee, balance and gas cost is in dollars — a buy's gas is under half a cent.
Everywhere: the trade sheet, your wallet, every receipt. · USDC 0x3600…0000
RAN ON TESTNET  Testnet launch, buys and sell paid gas in USDC; a buy cost about $0.004.
02
Deterministic finality
CONFIGURED
Deterministic finality: a transaction is final in the block that includes it (about every half second), no reorgs.
A buy is final in about a second. The receipt leads with the measured time from submit to receipt, taken by Juno’s server.
Trade receipt · landing figures · deterministic, ~0.5 s blocks
RAN ON TESTNET  Blocks about every 0.5 s on testnet; measured 1.1–1.3 s from submit to receipt through Juno’s server.
03
Memo
CONFIGURED
Arc's Memo contract makes a call as your wallet and logs a reference beside it.
Each curve buy and sell is tagged with its post's id, so trades are findable by post on chain.
Trade receipt: “Tagged with this post via Arc Memo” · 0x5294…e505
RAN ON TESTNET  Testnet launch, buy, sell and relayed buy were Memo-tagged.
04
Gasless buys (EIP-3009)
CONFIGURED
USDC's receiveWithAuthorization: a signature moves the money, someone else pays the gas.
“Pay with signature — no gas”: you sign, Juno's relayer submits the buy and pays the USDC gas.
Trade sheet · relayer configured; requires USDC gas
RAN ON TESTNET  One relayed buy on testnet: the buyer paid exactly the trade, no gas.
05
Circle Gateway
CONFIGURED
A unified USDC balance across chains, Circle attests a burn intent and Juno’s relayer mints the USDC on Arc.
Deposit once on Base or Ethereum, spend it here; top up a buy from Gateway when Arc USDC is short.
Profile → wallet · trade sheet “Top up from Gateway” · 7 source chains
RAN ON TESTNET  Deposit from Arc exercised on testnet. Attestation and mint from another chain: not run on testnet.
06
Circle CCTP V2
CONFIGURED
Native USDC burned on one chain, minted on another.
Creators withdraw trading fees straight to Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana… as native USDC.
Creator earnings · coin page “Withdraw fees to…” · domain 26 · 11 destinations
RAN ON TESTNET  A real burn through TokenMessengerV2 on testnet; the mint on the other chain was not completed.
07
Chainlink CCIP Cross-Chain Tokens
CONFIGURED
A token pool per coin: burned on Arc, minted on the destination, rate-limited per lane.
A graduated coin's creator makes it cross-chain in one transaction; holders send it to Base Sepolia or Ethereum Sepolia, fee in USDC. Arc's supply can never exceed the launch supply.
Graduated coin page → Cross-chain · 4 lanes · router 0xdE4E…eab8
FORK-PROVEN  Contracts are deployed on testnet; enabling and sending a coin is proven on a fork of Arc testnet, not run live (a coin must graduate first).
08
Chainlink Data Feeds
CONFIGURED
Decentralised price feeds — BTC, ETH, SOL, LINK, gold, EUR, JPY… — read from Arc mainnet.
Trackers follow a feed: the coin page shows NAV, what the curve implies, the premium and the band. USDC's own peg is shown beside prices.
Trade → Trackers · tracker coin pages · the peg chip · 10 feeds on Arc mainnet
DISPLAY-ONLY  Feeds exist on Arc mainnet only: on testnet, prices are mainnet reads for display and nothing is marked on chain.
